# powerhmc_vios (Resource)

Manages a Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) partition on an IBM Power Systems managed system.

A VIOS is a specialized partition that virtualizes storage and network resources
for the client LPARs on a managed system. Use this resource to create a VIOS
partition and assign its memory, processor, and physical I/O slot resources. If a
VIOS with the same name already exists on the managed system, creation fails —
use `terraform import` to bring the existing partition under management instead.

~> **VIOS partitions are immutable.** Changing any managed attribute
(`system_name`, `vios_name`, `mem_config`, `io_slots`, `proc_config`, or
`profile_name`) forces destroy-and-recreate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The powerhmc_vios resource creates and manages a Virtual I/O Server (VIOS)
# partition on an IBM Power Systems managed system. VIOS partitions are
# immutable: changing any managed attribute forces destroy and recreate.

##############################################
# Example 1: VIOS with dedicated processors
##############################################
resource "powerhmc_vios" "dedicated" {
  system_name  = "PowerSystem1"
  vios_name    = "vios1"
  profile_name = "default_profile"

  # Memory configuration, in megabytes (MB).
  mem_config = {
    desired = 8192
    min     = 4096
    max     = 16384
  }

  # Dedicated processor modes require desired/min/max_proc.
  proc_config = {
    proc_mode    = "keep_idle_procs"
    desired_proc = 2
    min_proc     = 1
    max_proc     = 4
  }

  # Physical I/O slot device locations to assign to the VIOS.
  io_slots = ["C18-L1-T1", "C19-L1-T1"]
}

##############################################
# Example 2: VIOS with shared (uncapped) processors
##############################################
resource "powerhmc_vios" "shared" {
  system_name = "PowerSystem1"
  vios_name   = "vios2"

  mem_config = {
    desired = 4096
    min     = 2048
    max     = 8192
  }

  # Shared processor modes (cap/uncap) require virtual processor and
  # processing unit attributes.
  proc_config = {
    proc_mode            = "uncap"
    desired_virtual_proc = 2
    min_virtual_proc     = 1
    max_virtual_proc     = 4
    desired_proc_units   = "0.5"
    min_proc_units       = "0.1"
    max_proc_units       = "2.0"
    shared_proc_pool_id  = 0
  }

  # Bound how long Terraform waits for the VIOS to be created or deleted.
  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
    delete = "20m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `mem_config` (Attributes) Memory configuration for the VIOS partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mem_config))
- `proc_config` (Attributes) Processor configuration for the VIOS partition. Required attributes depend on the processor mode (`proc_mode`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proc_config))
- `system_name` (String) The name of the managed system where the VIOS will be created.
- `vios_name` (String) The name of the VIOS partition.

### Optional

- `io_slots` (List of String) List of physical I/O slot location codes to assign to the VIOS partition. Supports partial (e.g., `C9-T1`) or full location codes (e.g., `U78AE.001.WZS0225-P1-C9-T1`).
- `profile_name` (String) The name of the partition profile. Must start with a letter or digit and contain up to 31 characters. Allowed symbols: `@#^/;:~,.-_=+{}`. Defaults to `default_profile`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `rmc_state` (String) The current RMC (Resource Monitoring and Control) state of the VIOS partition.
- `state` (String) The current state of the VIOS partition.
- `vios_uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the VIOS partition.

<a id="nestedatt--mem_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mem_config`

Required:

- `desired` (Number) Desired memory allocation in megabytes (MB). Must be greater than 0 and a multiple of the memory region size for the managed system.
- `max` (Number) Maximum memory allocation in megabytes (MB). Must be greater than 0 and a multiple of the memory region size for the managed system.
- `min` (Number) Minimum memory allocation in megabytes (MB). Must be greater than 0 and a multiple of the memory region size for the managed system.

Read-Only:

- `current_mem` (Number) Current memory allocation in megabytes (MB).


<a id="nestedatt--proc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proc_config`

Required:

- `proc_mode` (String) Processor sharing mode. Valid values: `cap` (capped shared), `uncap` (uncapped shared), `keep_idle_procs` (dedicated keep idle), `share_idle_procs` (dedicated share idle), `share_idle_procs_active` (dedicated share idle active), `share_idle_procs_always` (dedicated share idle always).

Optional:

- `desired_proc` (Number) Desired number of dedicated processors. Required for dedicated processor modes.
- `desired_proc_units` (String) Desired processing units as a decimal string. Required for shared processor modes.
- `desired_virtual_proc` (Number) Desired number of virtual processors. Required for shared processor modes.
- `max_proc` (Number) Maximum number of dedicated processors. Required for dedicated processor modes.
- `max_proc_units` (String) Maximum processing units as a decimal string. Required for shared processor modes.
- `max_virtual_proc` (Number) Maximum number of virtual processors. Required for shared processor modes.
- `min_proc` (Number) Minimum number of dedicated processors. Required for dedicated processor modes.
- `min_proc_units` (String) Minimum processing units as a decimal string. Required for shared processor modes.
- `min_virtual_proc` (Number) Minimum number of virtual processors. Required for shared processor modes.
- `shared_proc_pool_id` (Number) The ID of the shared processor pool. Only applicable for shared processor modes.

Read-Only:

- `current_proc` (Number) Current number of allocated dedicated processors.
- `current_proc_units` (String) Current processing units as a decimal string.
- `current_virtual_proc` (Number) Current number of allocated virtual processors.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Notes

<a id="choosing-a-processor-mode"></a>
### Choosing a processor mode

The valid attributes in `proc_config` depend on `proc_mode`. The provider
validates this at plan time:

* **Shared modes** — `cap`, `uncap`: the user can set `desired_virtual_proc`,
  `min_virtual_proc`, `max_virtual_proc`, `desired_proc_units`, `min_proc_units`,
  and `max_proc_units`. The dedicated attributes (`desired_proc`, `min_proc`,
  `max_proc`) must not be set.
* **Dedicated modes** — `keep_idle_procs`, `share_idle_procs`,
  `share_idle_procs_active`, `share_idle_procs_always`: the user can set `desired_proc`,
  `min_proc`, and `max_proc`. The shared attributes (virtual processors,
  processing units, `shared_proc_pool_id`) must not be set.

### Memory and profile constraints

Memory allocations in `mem_config` must satisfy `min <= desired <= max`. The
`profile_name` must start with a letter or digit and can contain up to 31
characters, including the symbols `@#^/;:~,-_=+{}` and a period.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# VIOS partitions are imported using the managed system name and VIOS name,
# separated by a forward slash: <system_name>/<vios_name>
terraform import powerhmc_vios.dedicated PowerSystem1/vios1
```
